_note: How the remedy a case type declares reads in the case's lifecycle menu (DqVolgendeStap, Bezwaar registreren): its id (the manifest maps it to a header action), its label and its description. Read by GET /api/case/{id}/acts as `remedies`. A fragment per ADR-037.

id.title: Menu id
id.description: The id the lifecycle menu knows this remedy by, e.g. objection; the manifest maps it to the dialog that lodges it.

label.title: Menu label
label.description: The menu entry, e.g. Bezwaar registreren.

description.title: Menu description
description.description: The line under the menu entry.
